title: Zang International with Lynette Zang: Treasury Market Risk: How Leveraged Buyers Become
description:
Original video author: Zang International with Lynette Zang. Independent recap and commentary; no endorsement implied. Treasury market risk is the focus of this recap of Zang International with Lynette Zang’s warning about buyers dependent on borrowed money. We cover her cited Federal Reserve findings: about $2.4 trillion in large hedge funds’ long-term Treasury exposure, nearly half tied to highly leveraged arbitrage strategies, and 90% of total Treasury exposure concentrated among 50 funds. Next, we explain her concern that lenders pulling back can turn liquidity-providing buyers into sellers.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
